row.title: Product Manager - Project Intern (Global Monetization Product and Technology) - 2027 Start
row.description: The Ads Platform and Interfaces teams build the advertiser-facing products, platforms, and services businesses use to create, manage, and optimize advertising campaigns on TikTok. Advertisers and internal product teams depend on these systems for seamless, reliable experiences at global scale. We work on complex challenges across scalability, system performance, platform reliability, and rapidly evolving customer needs, on systems where campaign delivery and business outcomes ride on how well they perform. You will shape the core advertising experience, on work with measurable impact for millions of businesses worldwide. The TikTok Marketing API team is responsible for building and managing the foundational programmatic infrastructure for TikTok’s advertising ecosystem. Our scope includes API, MCP, partner integrations, and technology partner and agency co-development. We build the products and platform capabilities that allow developers, partners, agencies, and advertisers to programmatically create, manage, optimize, and scale advertising workflows on TikTok. As a project intern, you will have the opportunity to engage in impactful short-term projects that provide you with a glimpse of professional real-world experience. You will gain practical skills through on-the-job learning in a fast-paced work environment and develop a deeper understanding of your career interests. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis - we encourage you to apply early. Responsibilities: - Translate business needs into clear, actionable product requirements. Partner with business and product stakeholders to clarify objectives, scope, and success criteria; develop PRDs; and align cross-functional teams and engineering on requirements, dependencies, and delivery milestones to keep execution on track. - Support product planning and execution for ads integration and plugins capabilities across APIs, SDKs, developer tooling, documentation, sandbox environments, debugging workflows, and overall developer experience. - Partner closely with engineering to help design and launch developer-facing product improvements, including API capabilities, authentication flows, schemas, validation systems, testing tools, observability, and integration support infrastructure. - Learn and synthesize the needs of developers, technology partners, agencies, advertisers, and internal teams; help translate those needs into clear product requirements and prioritized opportunities. - Assist with product discovery and analysis across external partners and internal stakeholders, including workflow research, competitive analysis, technical feasibility assessment, and feedback synthesis. - Collaborate with partner-facing teams to identify integration pain points, product gaps, adoption blockers, and opportunities to make TikTok’s platform easier and more reliable for developers and partners to use. - Help define and track success metrics for developer platform products, including API adoption, integration quality, developer satisfaction, documentation quality, tooling usage, and partner impact. - Work across TikTok’s API surfaces, including Marketing APIs, Organic APIs, Business Messaging APIs, and emerging automation-oriented or AI-enabled platform capabilities. - Support cross-functional alignment on scoped product priorities, user needs, implementation tradeoffs, and launch readiness. - Create clear product documents, requirements, analyses, and internal enablement materials to support team alignment and execution.
row.qualifications: Minimum Qualifications: - Currently in the process of obtaining a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related fields. - Academic background in computer science or related fields, with technical experience or project work preferred - Interest in product management, developer platforms, APIs, SDKs, integrations, automation products, or workflow systems, demonstrated through coursework, projects, research, or prior internship experience. - Strong technical aptitude and comfort learning about APIs, authentication, request/response structures, integration patterns, developer workflows, and system interactions. - Ability to break down ambiguous user, partner, or business needs into structured problem statements, product ideas, and actionable next steps. - Able to intern for 3 months or longer; candidates available to work 5 days a week are preferred. - Must be able to commit to a 12-week full-time work period during winter By submitting an application for this role, you accept and agree to our global applicant privacy policy, which may be accessed here: https://careers.tiktok.com/legal/privacy

row.title: 2027 Summer Intern – Actuarial
row.description: About the Role At Equitable, we help clients secure their financial well-being so they can pursue long and fulfilling lives - a mission we’ve honed since 1859. We are seeking motivated and curious Summer 2027 Interns to join our team and contribute to meaningful work that supports key business priorities. Interns will gain hands-on experience through impactful projects, cross-functional collaboration, data-driven analysis, and strategic initiatives that help inform business decisions. This opportunity provides valuable exposure to a dynamic, client-focused organization and the chance to develop professional skills while making a real impact. As an Actuarial Intern, you'll work alongside experienced actuaries on projects supporting pricing, valuation, actuarial modeling, financial reporting, and risk management. You'll also have opportunities to participate in rotational trainings, collaborate on a research topic, engage with leaders across the business, and present your work to senior leadership. In addition, you'll expand your professional network through mentorship, speaker series sessions, and networking events while gaining exposure to Finance functions including Actuarial, Accounting, Investments, and Treasury. This position offers a hybrid work schedule, with 2-3 days in office combining flexibility with team collaboration. What You’ll Be Doing Support actuarial projects involving valuation, financial reporting, pricing, modeling, and risk management. Analyze data and identify trends that help inform business decisions. Assist with actuarial evaluations, forecasting, and model development. Create reports, presentations, and analyses for business partners and leadership. Collaborate with actuaries and cross-functional teams on strategic initiatives. Participate in networking, professional development, and Finance Speaker Series events. Complete a capstone project and present findings and recommendations to business leaders. Internship Details Dates: Ten-week program starting in early June 2027 Hourly Rate: $26/hour Location: Charlotte, NC or New York, NY
row.qualifications: What You’ll Bring Required Currently enrolled in an undergraduate or graduate program (rising senior preferred) Pursuing a degree in Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Finance, Economics, Data Science, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field. Demonstrated interest in actuarial science, insurance, or financial services. Preferred Passing score on at least one actuarial exam. GPA of 3.5 or higher in a quantitative field of study. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other Microsoft Office applications. Skills Analytical Thinking: Uses data and quantitative reasoning to evaluate information, identify trends, and solve complex problems. Attention to Detail: Understands the importance of accuracy and consistently delivers high-quality work with precision. Communication: Express ideas clearly through written, verbal, and presentation-based formats while adapting to different audiences. Collaboration: Work effectively with team members and external partners to build strong relationships and achieve shared goals. Curiosity & Continuous Learning: Demonstrates initiative, asks thoughtful questions, and seeks opportunities to expand knowledge and improve processes. About Equitable At Equitable, we’re a team committed to helping our clients secure their financial well-being so that they can pursue long and fulfilling lives. We turn challenges into opportunities by thinking, working, and leading differently – where everyone is a leader. We encourage every employee to leverage their unique talents to become a force for good at Equitable and in their local communities. We are continuously investing in our people by offering growth, internal mobility, comprehensive compensation and benefits to support overall well-being, flexibility, and a culture of collaboration and teamwork. We are looking for talented, dedicated, purposeful people who want to make an impact. Join Equitable and pursue a career with purpose. Click Careers at Equitable to learn more. ********** Equitable is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to our employees, applicants and candidates based on individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity and expression, age, national origin, mental or physical disabilities, sexual orientation, veteran status, genetic information or any other class protected by federal, state and local laws. NOTE: Equitable participates in the E-Verify program. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process or to perform the essential job functions of this position, please contact Human Resources at (212) 314-2211 or email us at TalentAcquisition@equitable.com .
